items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: She was a famous Latin, from Spain, opera singer pretty much.

ctx.x: She was a famous Latin, from Spain, opera singer pretty much. I mean she did — back in the early ‘20’s I guess it was, she did, she was with RCA Victor and what other — my wife — what other label, honey? Oh Brunswick as well. But that was when they did titles you know, one title. And she would go in to the studios and do these different titles. And she recorded, jeez, thousands of titles you know back in the day. And she would travel and she was very big in South America and traveled all over. She was born in…
Well you came out of a family of musicians too so you’ve got it surrounded.
